condition: f_oneway(..., equal_var=False) overflows when summing the Welch weights for inputs with extremely small scale (e.g. 2**-511), so it returns a wrong F statistic and p-value.
workaround: Rescale the inputs (for example, divide each group by its overall standard deviation) before calling f_oneway. Welch's ANOVA is scale-invariant, so the result stays the same.
